name: runtime_provider_host_derived_api_key
notes: Env-var derivation from base-URL host (registrable label). Harness traces a faithful C copy of provider_registry.c::provider_host_derived_api_key incl. its own base_url_hostname PoP. KNOWN DIVERGENCE (excluded from walk): LIVE rejects when ANY digit appears in the last label, C only when the last label STARTS with a digit — hosts with mid-label digits avoided. Vendor env names are read via getenv on both sides over the same process env, so cups match whether or not a var is set.
